evidence.claim: Row‑major iteration consumes each cache line almost fully before moving to the next line, providing excellent locality.
evidence.quote: Modern CPUs fetch memory in cache lines, commonly 64 bytes. With int at 4 bytes, one line holds 16 elements. Row-major iteration through matrix[i][j] with j inner means each fetched line is consumed almost fully before the next line. That is excellent locality.

evidence.claim: Column‑wise traversal on row‑major storage often touches one element per cache line, wasting most of the fetched data.
